source_snapshot.procedure: Match recipe; clear logs; change all/random Memory Configuration settings; save/reboot and confirm retention; Load Defaults/save/reboot and confirm SPEC; collect photos/logs.
source_snapshot.criteria: No errors or reboot failure; changed setting persists; default matches SPEC.
source_snapshot.script: No bundle; 5 attended/20 machine minutes; unique row/variant.
source_snapshot.deepseek: NO; requires manual BIOS navigation but omits unsafe random memory controls, training behavior and DIMM/RAS evidence.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: MANUAL ONLY/HIGH; required exact DIMM identity, reversible matrix, training deadline, capacity/speed/ECC/NUMA evidence, preserved RAS logs and physical recovery.

old_problem: The historical record awaited Memory Configuration defaults, safe values, training/topology acceptance and recovery because Master requests all/random modification and log clearing.
disposition_reason: The approved BIOS rule establishes reversible one-setting-at-a-time execution and prohibits all/random changes. For Memory Configuration, a population-bound matrix plus signed training, DIMM inventory, speed, ECC, NUMA/interleave and RAS criteria defines a safe complete case. Exact values and recovery are runtime project configuration, while logs and counters remain preserved.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2179, same-row DeepSeek columns, GPT V2, historical record, unique identity and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next formal row Functionality 2180 / Wistron-BIOS-00497-V004 / 8a40e66d648108b7 was directly read from XLSX, manifest and historical record.
Reject all/random; approve one reversible memory control or coherent dependency group compatible with the installed DIMMs.
Bind motherboard/CPU/BIOS/microcode and each DIMM serial, PN, slot, channel, rank and capacity.
Define training deadline and compare POST, slot presence, total capacity, speed, ECC/RAS, NUMA/interleave and error deltas after each phase.
Qualified operator performs KVM changes and observes potentially long training; no early power interruption or automatic retry.
Preserve training, SEL, EDAC/MCA and kernel evidence; sign Load-Defaults scope and KVM/physical/CMOS recovery before save.
No BIOS setting, log/counter, reboot/training, Load Defaults, recovery or DUT action was performed.

test_case.test_name: Controlled Memory Configuration training, persistence and default-restoration validation
test_case.purpose: Verify each approved reversible memory control persists and restores to Project SPEC while every populated DIMM trains with expected slot, capacity, speed, ECC/RAS and NUMA/interleave state.
required_package: Qualified BIOS/KVM operator and maintenance window
Project-default and population-aware reversible value matrix
test_case.test_command: Qualified operator records the baseline Memory Configuration page, DIMM inventory and preserved training/RAS evidence; changes one approved reversible control or dependency group, saves and waits the full signed training deadline, validates POST and effective memory state, re-enters BIOS to prove retention, then performs approved Load Defaults and repeats page, training, inventory and RAS comparisons. Stop at the first anomaly.
test_case.expected_result: Each approved value persists; every populated DIMM trains within the approved deadline with expected slots, capacity, speed, ECC/RAS and NUMA/interleave; after Load Defaults all scoped values and effective memory state equal Project SPEC without prohibited new errors.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS only for the approved matrix when visual retention/restoration and every signed training, inventory, topology and error criterion match. Missing/disabled DIMM, capacity/speed/topology drift, training failure or disallowed RAS event is FAIL. Missing runtime oracle or recovery is BLOCKED.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED until platform/DIMM identity, defaults, values/dependencies, training limits and recovery are signed.
Never execute all/random or values incompatible with installed DIMMs/CPU.
Preserve training, SEL, EDAC/MCA and kernel evidence; no clearing or early power interruption.
Operator controls save/reboot/training/Load-Defaults/recovery; no automatic retry or CMOS clear.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash, authorization and platform/per-DIMM identity
Baseline, changed, retained, Load-Defaults and restored screenshots plus training timing/POST codes
Per-phase DIMM slots/channels/ranks, total capacity, speed, ECC/RAS and NUMA/interleave
Restored state, discrepancy/recovery record and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: Stop on training loop, missing DIMM, topology/error anomaly or no-boot and preserve evidence. Wait the signed training deadline before intervention; qualified personnel then use only the last-known-good KVM/physical/CMOS recovery, without blind cycling or retry.

source_conflict.reason: Target and acceptance consistently cover Memory Configuration persistence/default restoration; unsafe all/random wording is constrained without dropping DIMM/training coverage.

blocked.reason: The safe manual memory method is clear; exact values, training/topology oracle and recovery are runtime inputs.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: Platform/per-DIMM identity, Project SPEC defaults, reversible values/dependencies, training/POST and capacity/speed/ECC/NUMA/RAS limits, Load-Defaults scope and recovery.
pending.execution_status: REVIEW RESOLVED AS PARAMETERIZED MANUAL TEST; RUNTIME PROJECT CONFIGURATION AND EXPLICIT CONFIRMATION REQUIRED; NO BIOS, LOG, TRAINING, DEFAULT, RECOVERY OR DUT ACTION EXECUTED
pending.owner: BIOS/memory platform owner and qualified KVM/physical operator
pending.unlock_condition: Populate and sign population-specific values, training/topology criteria and recovery before execution; absence blocks execution but not review resolution.

external_authorities.authority: User-approved ED-11 BIOS safety principle and ED-01 through ED-30
external_authorities.application: Uses approved one-setting-at-a-time execution while preserving memory-training and per-DIMM evidence.

project_authority: BIOS/memory owner signs controls, defaults, training/effective-state criteria and recovery; operator performs manual workflow; end engineer owns verdict.
